dart.rights_scope: OpenDART permits extraction of desired data from XML. Bounded private facts for FORMULA6.4/20260723 ACODE11324 correction only; excludes raw document, image, signature and attachment redistribution. Current retrieval of a historical filing does not establish latest terms or issuance completion. No live HTTP permission.
dart.private_retention_basis: Bounded current-list and single XML ZIP in private run memory only; no public raw body/images/signatures/attachments. Optional manual diagnostic capture uses ignored0700/0600 and recipient-encrypted artifact retained one day. Generated field paragraph <=1200 characters preserves exact XML field values.
